dedupe_keys.name: high speed railway network processing code

description: This Zenodo release and linked GitHub repository provide Python scripts used to build a Chinese high-speed railway network dataset from train records and weather. The README lists routines for correcting abnormal records, calculating train and station delays, deriving adjacent-station mileage, and joining weather and holidays. A rail modeller can inspect those steps when turning raw operation observations into disruption or delay inputs. The scripts are tied to the source record structure and do not provide a general timetable simulator. Zenodo marks the code release as open with the literal licence value other-open; GitHub has no structured licence, so this draft does not infer a standard grant. I read repository metadata and README without downloading the source archive or executing code. The resulting Figshare data are already catalogued under data-china-high-speed-railway-operation-weather. No catalogue code record was found. The published scripts cover Chinese high-speed rail records from the dataset period, not all rail systems. Coverage is the national high-speed rail network of China during the source study.
